gloss: first match; opening game; first battle

definitions.gloss: first match; opening game; first round
definitions.explanation: The first game or match in a tournament, series, or competition. Also refers to the first battle in a war or military campaign.

examples.japanese: {初戦|しょせん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{月曜日|げつようび}→月曜日：00624_getsuyoubi⟧だ。
examples.english: The first match is next Monday.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{初戦|しょせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{白星|しろぼし}→白星：19036_shiroboshi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{飾|かざ}った→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧。
examples.english: The Japanese team celebrated their opening game with a win.

examples.japanese: {初戦|しょせん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{強豪|きょうごう}⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}たって→当たる：01860_ataru⟧しまった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{善戦|ぜんせん}→善戦：07902_zensen⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We were matched against a powerhouse team in the first round, but we put up a good fight.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{初|しょ}→初〜：03955_sho⟧ (first) + ⟦{戦|せん}→〜戦：28346_sen⟧ (match, battle). Used primarily in sports and competition contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {初戦|しょせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧: to win the opening match
- {初戦|しょせん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{敗退|はいたい}→敗退：06840_haitai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be eliminated in the first round
- {初戦|しょせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勝|か}つ→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧: to win the first match
- {初戦|しょせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧: first-round opponent

NOTE ON HOMOPHONES:
Do not confuse with ⟦{所詮|しょせん}→所詮：10920_shosen⟧ (after all, in the end), which is pronounced the same but has a completely different meaning.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {第一戦|だいいっせん}: first match (in a series) — can refer to game one of a multi-game series
- ⟦{開幕戦|かいまくせん}→開幕戦：22724_kaimakusen⟧: opening game (of a season) — specifically the season opener
